verdict.rationale: Base44's CLI 'eject'/clone command lets users download frontend code and backend resources into a new local project with its own app ID, and the SDK/GitHub sync support building outside the platform, giving real portability of app logic. However, there's no explicit documentation of exporting the actual data records (e.g., CSV/JSON dump of table rows) in an open format, only code/resources — missing for 10: explicit bulk data-record export format, confirmation the ejected app runs fully independent of Base44 services, and independent/hands-on verification that a full clean exit works.
